newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BRAZIL'S RIVALDO SIGNS FOR BARCELONA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BRAZIL'S RIVALDO SIGNS FOR BARCELONA.

text.p: Deportivo Coruna's Brazilian international midfielder Rivaldo has signed for Barcelona, Spanish state television reported on Thursday.
Exact transfer details were still to be announced, but the television reported that the club would pay four billion pesetas ($25.8 million) to buy out Rivaldo's contract.

Meanwhile, sources close to Liverpool reported that Barcelona and the English premier league club had agreed a 12 million pounds ($19 million) transfer deal taking England midfielder Steve McManaman to Spain. The sources said McManaman was in Barcelona but personal terms had yet to be agreed.
Barcelona general manager Bobby Robson was at Anfield on Wednesday to watch McManaman in a premier league match against Leicester.
McManaman's contract expires at the end of next season, leaving Liverpool the option of cashing in or facing the prospect of losing him for no reward.
Club officials were not immediately available but sources said Barcelona were holding a board meeting and an announcement was expected on Friday.
